about: Reference outputs of catsim, recorded by tests/reference/generate.py from the source that provenance.json names. They change only where an ADR changes a result, and the pull request that changes them names the ADR and the outputs. Floats compare to 1e-12 of their magnitude or unit, and the estimates of a numerical search, away from the recording environment, to its tolerance; everything else exactly (see tests/reference/records.py).
